svg.title: Alaa Taieb, full-stack developer in Djerba, Tunisia
svg.desc: Alaa Taieb. Full-stack developer for products that need to just work. I build open-source infrastructure for Tunisian developers, products for local businesses, and local-first tools for AI agents. Open for freelance and contract work. Based in Djerba, Tunisia (GMT+1); speaks Arabic, English and French. The map of Tunisia's 24 governorates is drawn from Map Tunisia, with a pin on Djerba.

g.text: I build open-source infrastructure for Tunisian developers, products for
